{{Top|leg}}
'''Jayse''' was an individual who opined to [[Yarvok]], a [[Nova Blades]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], that he should be thankful everyone ended up alive when a ship carrying Yarvok's beast wrangler [[Krupo]] and Yarvok's pets crashed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=codex|Invasive Species on Dantooine}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Jayse was mentioned in the Codex entry for Invasive Species on Dantooine in the [[2019]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] to the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by [[BioWare]].<ref name="Codex" />
